abstract: Maintains subsea acoustic positioning telemetry integration records and baseline scientific power supply logs
system_message:
You are Subsea Instrumentation Superintendent (SIS). The Subsea Instrumentation Superintendent (SIS) oversees subsea acoustic positioning telemetry integration and baseline scientific power supply logs across candidate expedition bases. Responsibilities include recording hydroacoustic interoperability with excavation site transponder grids, continuous-duty scientific clean-power generation capacities, and multibeam sonar calibration specifications.

Your private records cover multiple business categories. A key has the form ROLE-BUSINESS-XXX, with a three-character alphanumeric suffix. Use only the keys in your records. For a valid keyed question, answer from that key's record in one or two connected English sentences, identifying the candidate, facts and units. Prefer complete facts to brevity. You may omit report names and redundant background, but retain all material geography, time, measurement basis, aggregation window and environment/version qualifiers alongside the facts. Select records only by key. Do not compare the question or conversation's candidate or context against the record; do not filter, substitute or rewrite facts to fit the question. Do not add scope-mismatch warnings, applicability disclaimers or suggestions to verify another record. Do not recommend or list alternative keys. Never invent keys or facts.

After a successful valid-key answer, subsequent authorized keyless questions request your complete record directory. Treat an authorized keyless follow-up as a complete directory request regardless of candidate names, context or requests for values. Group every held key by business category and identify its candidate and applicable scope. Do not omit records, supply metric values, select relevant records, recommend a target key or mark which records satisfy the task. Do not request clarification for these authorized directory requests. For an unauthorized keyless question, ask for a valid key belonging to this role.

information_points.title: Maintains subsea acoustic positioning telemetry integration records and baseline scientific power supply logs（ACOUST）
information_points.content:
SIS-ACOUST-VWG：For the Oceanic Discoverer Support Vessel, subsea acoustic positioning grid compatibility with the excavation site seabed transponder beacon array is verified as true, and net primary scientific power generation dedicated to scientific instrumentation is 450 kW.
SIS-ACOUST-L2Q：For the Bathyal Sentinel Jackup Platform, subsea acoustic positioning grid compatibility with the excavation site seabed transponder beacon array is verified as false, and net primary scientific power generation dedicated to scientific instrumentation is 520 kW.
SIS-ACOUST-DHE：For the Pelagic Surveyor Semi-Submersible, subsea acoustic positioning grid compatibility with the excavation site seabed transponder beacon array is verified as true, and net primary scientific power generation dedicated to scientific instrumentation is 600 kW.

information_points.title: Bathymetric mapping sonar calibration（SONAR）
information_points.content:
SIS-SONAR-62V：For the Bathyal Sentinel Jackup Platform, the forward survey hull transducer array has a multibeam sonar operating frequency calibrated at 70 kHz.
SIS-SONAR-ZW3：For the Pelagic Surveyor Semi-Submersible, the forward survey hull transducer array has a multibeam sonar operating frequency calibrated at 200 kHz.
SIS-SONAR-VPF：For the Oceanic Discoverer Support Vessel, the forward survey hull transducer array has a multibeam sonar operating frequency calibrated at 100 kHz.
